data.exact_reserve_text: Within the calendar year technical result, a surplus of GBP 8.3m (2013: GBP 71.6m) relates to the reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years. Of the prior year surplus, US$104.1m and GBP 0.2m related to the release of reserves on Thai Floods.

prior_year_events.impact_description: further reduction to the reserves held for the 2011 Thai Flood event, due to claims settling for less than their reserves
transfer of all remaining unpaid liabilities on the 2013 and prior years of account from Syndicate 1880 to Tokio Marine & Nichido Fire Insurance Co., Ltd.

named_events.loss_description: further reduction to the reserves held for the 2011 Thai Flood event, due to claims settling for less than their reserves

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a net release of GBP 8.3 million in prior year reserves, primarily driven by a further reduction in reserves for the 2011 Thai Flood event as claims settled for less than initially reserved. Additionally, a portfolio transfer of unpaid liabilities for 2013 and prior years of account to a related party also impacted prior year liabilities, affecting Property, Reinsurance, and Accident & Health divisions.
raw_causal_phrases: a surplus of GBP 8.3m ... relates to the reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years
further reduction to the reserves held for the 2011 Thai Flood event, due to claims settling for less than their reserves
repayment of a loss fund that was no longer required relating to the Thai Flood event in 2011

a premiums and claims portfolio transfer was performed in respect of these treaties to transfer all remaining unpaid liabilities on the 2013 and prior years of account from Syndicate 1880 to Tokio Marine & Nichido Fire Insurance Co., Ltd.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development figure is stated as a net amount in the narrative, as a gross figure was not explicitly provided in a dedicated note or gross claims development triangle. The percentage calculation uses this net figure against opening gross reserves.
